case_scope: United Kingdom offshore real-estate ownership and beneficial-control visibility subsystem case

beneficial_ownership_verification.note: Entity and legal-arrangement coverage must identify natural-person control.

offshore_property_visibility.note: Offshore property ownership requires linkage between land title, entity chain, and controller.

trust_legal_arrangement_coverage.note: Trust and similar legal arrangements require separate controller and beneficiary disclosure.

wealth_to_rule_risk.note: Hidden high-value land/property ownership can affect sanctions, tax, planning, and political trust.

enforcement_statistics.note: Need penalties, collections, restrictions, and remediation rates.

proof_debt: share of property owned through offshore entities trusts nominees and layered vehicles
stale false and noncompliant filing rates
local vacancy and housing-market impact data

opening_package.hardening_lane: update duty penalties and public-interest access

reopening_triggers: enforcement data show high compliance and penalties collected
new research maps hidden controller reduction

ownership_visibility.why: Legal title is insufficient where offshore/entity chains obscure control.

wealth_to_rule.why: Opaque land/control assets create political and enforcement risk.

evidence_debt_register.question: Can UK property registers identify ultimate natural-person controllers, including through trusts?
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: linked land-register, overseas-entity, trust, sanctions, and enforcement data

validation_notes: Subsystem case; connects housing/land, top-tail measurement, and wealth-to-rule gates.
rev0339 UK offshore-property hardening: official Companies House/GOV.UK ROE guidance S489 added as direct currentness anchor.
